name: Friuli Venezia Giulia (L.R. 44/1985 e L.R. 19/2009)
references: Legge regionale Friuli Venezia Giulia 23 agosto 1985, n. 44: altezze minime e principali requisiti igienico-sanitari dei locali adibiti ad abitazione (testo vigente dal 14/05/2024)
Legge regionale Friuli Venezia Giulia 11 novembre 2009, n. 19: Codice regionale dell'edilizia, art. 39 (testo vigente dal 30/10/2026)
note: Friuli Venezia Giulia's rules over DM 5 July 1975, for a building below 400 m above sea level in a seismic zone, as most of the region is: habitable rooms 2.50 m high, service rooms 2.40 m (LR 44/1985 art. 2), bedrooms of 8 and 12 m² and a living room of 12 m² (art. 6), openable windows of 1/10 of the floor (art. 7). An attic made habitable (LR 19/2009 art. 39) is 1.90 m high on average, never under 1.30 m, with openable windows of 1/20 of the floor. Above 400 m the rooms may be 2.40 m high with windows of 1/12: a project there changes those rules.

sources.rooms: LR FVG 44/1985: art. 2 (habitable rooms 2.50 m below 400 m above sea level, service rooms 2.40 m), art. 6 (bedrooms 8 and 12 m², living room 12 m², in a seismic zone or above 400 m), art. 7 (openable windows of 1/10 of the floor below 400 m in a seismic zone); LR FVG 19/2009 art. 39 comma 1 (an attic made habitable: average height 1.90 m, never under 1.30 m, openable windows of 1/20 of the floor, the room's volume no less than its least area by that height)
